data.one_liner: Flutter library for the Bitcoin Development Kit (BDK) to build Bitcoin applications
data.what_it_does: It provides a Flutter wrapper around the Bitcoin Development Kit (BDK), enabling developers to create wallets, manage descriptors, handle transactions, and synchronize with the Bitcoin blockchain using Electrum or other backends.
use_when: You are building a Bitcoin wallet application in Flutter
You need to create and manage Bitcoin descriptors, keys, and mnemonics
You need to build, sign, and broadcast Bitcoin transactions
avoid_when: You are working with non-Bitcoin cryptocurrencies like Ethereum or Solana
You only need basic crypto hashing without wallet or blockchain features
strengths: Backed by the official Bitcoin Development Kit (BDK)
Provides low-level control over descriptors, wallets, and transactions
weaknesses: Requires specific native setup (Android min SDK 23, Java 17, NDK)
Complex API surface requiring familiarity with Bitcoin concepts
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSdkVersion API 23 or higher, Java 17, and android-ndk 26.3.11579264. iOS deployment target must be 12.0 or greater.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick web3dart if you are building on Ethereum rather than Bitcoin.

alternatives.name: blockchain_utils
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick blockchain_utils for general cryptocurrency utilities and serialization across multiple blockchains.
